narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Reliance Industries Limited demonstrated strong execution across its digital and consumer segments, systematically beating operational benchmarks. Jio continuously expanded its 5G subscriber base from 253 million in Q3 FY26 to 285 million in Q1 FY27, while FMCG revenues doubled to Rs.7350 Crores in Q4 FY26 following the December 1st demerger.
